scenarios.title: The cheap candidates are discriminated

linkedTests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG017-03 candidate classifications require distinguishing evidence

linkedTests: tests/lifetime-tax-combined.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-022-013 the request ledger does not grow after first paint and every entry is a declared same-origin read across the full combined workflow
tests/lifetime-tax-read-bound.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-021-03 the configuration read is bounded by its own stratum-0 declaration when that origin never responds
scenarios.mappingNote: The lifetime-tax tests identify the real workload held constant during process-level candidate runs but do not assert the candidate verdicts. The planned functional test is the exact carrier for candidate-table classification, distinguishing-evidence, and no-causal-label assertions.

obligations.requiredProof: Candidate runs hold the real workload constant while project, worker count, process state, and installed-version inputs vary.
satisfiedBy: tests/lifetime-tax-combined.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-022-013 the request ledger does not grow after first paint and every entry is a declared same-origin read across the full combined workflow
tests/lifetime-tax-read-bound.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-021-03 the configuration read is bounded by its own stratum-0 declaration when that origin never responds

obligations.requiredProof: Candidates 3 and 4 each carry an allowed supported, contradicted, or untested verdict plus candidate-specific distinguishing evidence, and neither is promoted to cause.
satisfiedBy: tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs#Regression: SCN-BUG017-03 candidate classifications require distinguishing evidence

testMechanism.negativeControl: One probe changes candidate 3 from contradicted to cause without changing its evidence; a second removes candidate 4's single-build rationale while preserving its untested label. Each must fail the exact SCN-BUG017-03 functional test.

scenarios.title: A developer meets the symptom

linkedTests.testId: Regression: SCN-BUG017-07 disclosure names its platform project symptom and intermittence

linkedTests: tests/lifetime-tax-combined.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-022-013 the combined total is the sum of two independent settlements
scenarios.mappingNote: The planned functional test asserts every required disclosure field and its placement independently on both developer-facing artifacts. The lifetime-tax test remains a concrete workload member and is not offered as disclosure-content proof.

obligations.requiredProof: Both developer-facing sites name macOS, system-chrome, the 300000ms force-kill and green-suite non-zero symptom, all three intermittence rates, and measured cost; each notice is placed before the worker override or run command it qualifies.
satisfiedBy: tests/playwright-runtime.foundation.functional.mjs#Regression: SCN-BUG017-07 disclosure names its platform project symptom and intermittence

testMechanism.negativeControl: Remove only the macOS clause from the config disclosure while preserving the comment, worker pin, and registry disclosure; the exact SCN-BUG017-07 test must fail with the missing-platform assertion.
